# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

---

## Pets Endpoints

### List Pets
```
GET /api/pets?status=lost&type=dog&skip=0&take=10

Response (200):
{
  "pets": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "dog",
      "gender": "male",
      "size": "medium",
      "primaryColor": "brown",
      "status": "lost",
      "description": "Perro marrón con collar azul",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-17T16:00:00Z",
      "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Juan Pérez",
        "email": "usuario@example.com",
        "phone": "999999999"
      },
      "images": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "imageUrl": "https://cloudinary.com/...",
          "isMain": true
        }
      ],
      "location": {
        "id": 1,
        "district": "Trujillo",
        "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
        "latitude": -8.109,
        "longitude": -79.021
      }
    }
  ],
  "total": 42,
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 10
}
```

### Create Pet
```
POST /api/pets
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "dog",
  "gender": "female",
  "size": "small",
  "primaryColor": "white",
  "status": "lost",
  "description": "Perrita pequeña, blanca",
  "location": {
    "district": "Trujillo",
    "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
    "latitude": -8.109,
    "longitude": -79.021
  }
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "Pet created successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Get Pet Detail
```
GET /api/pets/1

Response (200):
{
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Update Pet
```
PUT /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "found",
  "description": "Mascota encontrada - ya en casa"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet updated successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Delete Pet
```
DELETE /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet deleted successfully"
}
```

---

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

## Environment Variables Required

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db
JWT_SECRET=tu_jwt_secret_super_seguro
CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```

  status: 'found'

# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

// List pets

  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',

    longitude: -79.021
  }

  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  "message": "User registered successfully",

  }

| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |

import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```

  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

{
  "message": "User registered successfully",

  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db
JWT_SECRET=tu_jwt_secret_super_seguro
CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```
# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

---

## Pets Endpoints

### List Pets
```
GET /api/pets?status=lost&type=dog&skip=0&take=10

Response (200):
{
  "pets": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "dog",
      "gender": "male",
      "size": "medium",
      "primaryColor": "brown",
      "status": "lost",
      "description": "Perro marrón con collar azul",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-17T16:00:00Z",
      "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Juan Pérez",
        "email": "usuario@example.com",
        "phone": "999999999"
      },
      "images": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "imageUrl": "https://cloudinary.com/...",
          "isMain": true
        }
      ],
      "location": {
        "id": 1,
        "district": "Trujillo",
        "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
        "latitude": -8.109,
        "longitude": -79.021
      }
    }
  ],
  "total": 42,
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 10
}
```

### Create Pet
```
POST /api/pets
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "dog",
  "gender": "female",
  "size": "small",
  "primaryColor": "white",
  "status": "lost",
  "description": "Perrita pequeña, blanca",
  "location": {
    "district": "Trujillo",
    "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
    "latitude": -8.109,
    "longitude": -79.021
  }
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "Pet created successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Get Pet Detail
```
GET /api/pets/1

Response (200):
{
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Update Pet
```
PUT /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "found",
  "description": "Mascota encontrada - ya en casa"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet updated successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Delete Pet
```
DELETE /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet deleted successfully"
}
```

---

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  "message": "User registered successfully",

    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

);

// List pets

  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',

    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |

import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```

  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

{
  "message": "User registered successfully",

  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db
JWT_SECRET=tu_jwt_secret_super_seguro
CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```
# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

---

## Pets Endpoints

### List Pets
```
GET /api/pets?status=lost&type=dog&skip=0&take=10

Response (200):
{
  "pets": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "dog",
      "gender": "male",
      "size": "medium",
      "primaryColor": "brown",
      "status": "lost",
      "description": "Perro marrón con collar azul",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-17T16:00:00Z",
      "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Juan Pérez",
        "email": "usuario@example.com",
        "phone": "999999999"
      },
      "images": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "imageUrl": "https://cloudinary.com/...",
          "isMain": true
        }
      ],
      "location": {
        "id": 1,
        "district": "Trujillo",
        "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
        "latitude": -8.109,
        "longitude": -79.021
      }
    }
  ],
  "total": 42,
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 10
}
```

### Create Pet
```
POST /api/pets
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "dog",
  "gender": "female",
  "size": "small",
  "primaryColor": "white",
  "status": "lost",
  "description": "Perrita pequeña, blanca",
  "location": {
    "district": "Trujillo",
    "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
    "latitude": -8.109,
    "longitude": -79.021
  }
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "Pet created successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Get Pet Detail
```
GET /api/pets/1

Response (200):
{
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Update Pet
```
PUT /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "found",
  "description": "Mascota encontrada - ya en casa"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet updated successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Delete Pet
```
DELETE /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet deleted successfully"
}
```

---

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  "message": "User registered successfully",

    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

);

// List pets

  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',

    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |

import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```

  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

{
  "message": "User registered successfully",

  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db
JWT_SECRET=tu_jwt_secret_super_seguro
CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```
# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

---

## Pets Endpoints

### List Pets
```
GET /api/pets?status=lost&type=dog&skip=0&take=10

Response (200):
{
  "pets": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "dog",
      "gender": "male",
      "size": "medium",
      "primaryColor": "brown",
      "status": "lost",
      "description": "Perro marrón con collar azul",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-17T16:00:00Z",
      "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Juan Pérez",
        "email": "usuario@example.com",
        "phone": "999999999"
      },
      "images": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "imageUrl": "https://cloudinary.com/...",
          "isMain": true
        }
      ],
      "location": {
        "id": 1,
        "district": "Trujillo",
        "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
        "latitude": -8.109,
        "longitude": -79.021
      }
    }
  ],
  "total": 42,
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 10
}
```

### Create Pet
```
POST /api/pets
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "dog",
  "gender": "female",
  "size": "small",
  "primaryColor": "white",
  "status": "lost",
  "description": "Perrita pequeña, blanca",
  "location": {
    "district": "Trujillo",
    "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
    "latitude": -8.109,
    "longitude": -79.021
  }
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "Pet created successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Get Pet Detail
```
GET /api/pets/1

Response (200):
{
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Update Pet
```
PUT /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "found",
  "description": "Mascota encontrada - ya en casa"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet updated successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Delete Pet
```
DELETE /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet deleted successfully"
}
```

---

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  "message": "User registered successfully",

    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

);

// List pets

  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',

    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |

import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

---

```
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db

CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```

  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

{
  "message": "User registered successfully",

  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mascotas_db
JWT_SECRET=tu_jwt_secret_super_seguro
CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME=your_cloud_name
CLOUDINARY_API_KEY=your_api_key
CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET=your_api_secret
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://localhost:3000
```
# API Documentation - Portal de Mascotas

## Authentication Endpoints

### Register
```
POST /api/auth/register
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123",
  "name": "Juan Pérez"
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Login
```
POST /api/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "usuario@example.com",
  "password": "contraseña123"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "eyJhbGc...",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen"
  }
}
```

### Get Current User
```
GET /api/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "usuario@example.com",
    "name": "Juan Pérez",
    "role": "citizen",
    "phone": "999999999"
  }
}
```

---

## Pets Endpoints

### List Pets
```
GET /api/pets?status=lost&type=dog&skip=0&take=10

Response (200):
{
  "pets": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "type": "dog",
      "gender": "male",
      "size": "medium",
      "primaryColor": "brown",
      "status": "lost",
      "description": "Perro marrón con collar azul",
      "createdAt": "2026-05-17T16:00:00Z",
      "user": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "Juan Pérez",
        "email": "usuario@example.com",
        "phone": "999999999"
      },
      "images": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "imageUrl": "https://cloudinary.com/...",
          "isMain": true
        }
      ],
      "location": {
        "id": 1,
        "district": "Trujillo",
        "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
        "latitude": -8.109,
        "longitude": -79.021
      }
    }
  ],
  "total": 42,
  "skip": 0,
  "take": 10
}
```

### Create Pet
```
POST /api/pets
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "dog",
  "gender": "female",
  "size": "small",
  "primaryColor": "white",
  "status": "lost",
  "description": "Perrita pequeña, blanca",
  "location": {
    "district": "Trujillo",
    "address": "Jr. Principal 123",
    "latitude": -8.109,
    "longitude": -79.021
  }
}

Response (201):
{
  "message": "Pet created successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Get Pet Detail
```
GET /api/pets/1

Response (200):
{
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Update Pet
```
PUT /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "found",
  "description": "Mascota encontrada - ya en casa"
}

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet updated successfully",
  "pet": { ... }
}
```

### Delete Pet
```
DELETE /api/pets/1
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGc...

Response (200):
{
  "message": "Pet deleted successfully"
}
```

---

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  "message": "User registered successfully",

    "role": "citizen"
  }
}

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

);

// List pets

  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',

    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |

## Using Frontend API Client

```typescript
import { apiClient } from '@/lib/api-client';

// Register
const registerResult = await apiClient.register(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123',
  'Juan Pérez'
);

// Login
const loginResult = await apiClient.login(
  'user@example.com',
  'password123'
);

// Get current user
const me = await apiClient.getCurrentUser();

// List pets
const { pets, total } = await apiClient.getPets(0, 10, 'lost');

// Create pet
const { pet } = await apiClient.createPet({
  type: 'dog',
  gender: 'male',
  size: 'medium',
  primaryColor: 'brown',
  status: 'lost',
  description: 'Perro marrón',
  location: {
    district: 'Trujillo',
    address: 'Jr. Principal 123',
    latitude: -8.109,
    longitude: -79.021
  }
});

// Update pet
await apiClient.updatePet(1, {
  status: 'found'
});

// Delete pet
await apiClient.deletePet(1);
```

---

## Status Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | OK - Request successful |
| 201 | Created - Resource created successfully |
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid fields |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Permission denied |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource not found |
| 409 | Conflict - Email already exists |
| 500 | Server Error - Internal server error |
